_comment: Template for resume_data.json - Fill in your own information

experiences.title: Your Job Title
experiences.description: Describe your responsibilities and achievements. Use bullet points or sentences. Highlight key technologies, accomplishments, and impact (e.g., 'Reduced processing time by 50%', 'Led team of 5 developers').

education.degree: Degree Name (e.g., Bachelor of Science in Computer Science)
education.details: Additional details like GPA, honors, relevant coursework, thesis, etc.

portfolio.name: Project Name
portfolio.description: Brief description of the project, technologies used, and impact/achievements.

target_job: Optional: Describe the target job position you're applying for. This helps optimize the resume for that specific role. Example: 'Software Engineer position requiring Python, React, and cloud experience.'
